title: 美国民众花钱有负罪感？72%的人为快乐买单却纠结
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: People are starting to feel bad. They're starting to feel guilty when they spend money on things that are fun.
segments.zh: 人们开始感到不安，当他们在娱乐上花钱时会有负罪感。

segments.en: What happened to treat yourself? So in the new research by IWI Bank actually shows that 72% of Americans feel guilty about spending money on joy.
segments.zh: 那“犒劳自己”呢？IWI银行的新研究显示，72%的美国人对花钱买快乐感到内疚。

segments.en: Things that bring them happiness. Even when they can afford it, I think that disconnect is really interesting.
segments.zh: 即使他们负担得起，这种脱节也很有趣。

segments.en: Because being able to spend money on something doesn't mean that they have to feel comfortable about doing it.
segments.zh: 因为能花钱并不意味着他们对此感到自在。

segments.en: And of course there's this deeply ingrained money belief that if you're saving, you're being responsible about your future.
segments.zh: 当然，根深蒂固的金钱观念是：储蓄是对未来负责。

segments.en: And if you're spending something needs to be really well justified.
segments.zh: 而花钱则需要充分的理由。

segments.en: But it's also happening at a time of when we have a lot of anxiety about cost of living, rising, about unaffordable housing.
segments.zh: 但这也发生在生活成本上升、住房难以负担的焦虑时期。

segments.en: And uncertainty about economics in the economic future in America.
segments.zh: 以及对美国经济未来的不确定性。

segments.en: Yeah, it's a certainly sharp turn from the yellow days after the pandemic when everyone was going out and living their best lives and traveling everywhere.
segments.zh: 这确实与疫情后的狂欢日子形成鲜明对比，那时每个人都外出享受生活，到处旅行。

segments.en: How does it break down in terms of demographics? Are young people more susceptible to this than say the retirees, the boomers?
segments.zh: 从人口结构来看，年轻人比退休人员或婴儿潮一代更容易受影响吗？

segments.en: So older Americans like baby boomers and older, they feel slightly more comfortable about spending but they're still very conscious about what they're spending money on.
segments.zh: 年长的美国人，如婴儿潮一代及更年长者，对消费感到更自在，但仍非常在意消费内容。

segments.en: Especially right now, I feel like a lot of people, even the older Americans, they have anxiety about retiring with a regular paycheck.
segments.zh: 特别是现在，我觉得很多人，甚至年长的美国人，都担心退休后没有固定收入。
